description: The file tools (fileOps.create) as an ordered operation list. Stateful: each case runs its ops in order against a fresh project folder {base}/project and an in-memory checkpoint store; workspace w1 has that folder, any other has none. Ops: list, read, search, locate, write, edit, move, remove take workspace and path fields; revert takes undo (the index of an earlier op whose checkpoint it undoes) or id. Expected: {results: one normalized result per op, state: every file under the project as relative path to text}. Search hits are compared sorted by path and line. Size and count cases use generated trees: sized (zero bytes of a length), long (text from head, fill and tail), numbered (empty files by index); the 20 MB, 500-entry, 4000-file, 512 KB, 300-unit and 2 MB limits are all covered.

cases.name: a listing puts folders first, then names ignoring case
a listing of a folder shows the files inside it
a text file is read whole
an image is read as a data URL with its mime type
an SVG is read as its data URL and as its text
audio is read as media
a write makes its folders and records a checkpoint
an edit replaces the one occurrence and undo puts it back
an edit that finds nothing changes nothing

results.error: That text is not in the file. Read it again and copy the lines exactly, whitespace included.

cases.name: an edit that finds two occurrences is refused until the count is given

results.error: That text appears 2 times, not 1. Include more of the surrounding lines so it matches once, or say how many to replace.

cases.name: a delete goes to the bin and undo brings the file back
a folder cannot be deleted

results.error: Draggy does not delete folders. Name the files instead.

cases.name: a move renames the file and undo moves it back
a move onto an existing file is refused
undo of a created file takes it away again
undo of an edit to a file created by the same run restores the earlier text
a workspace with no folder refuses every operation

results.error: This conversation has no folder to work in. Open a project first.
This conversation has no folder to work in. Open a project first.
This conversation has no folder to work in. Open a project first.

cases.name: search finds text with its line, skipping credentials and generated folders
search by name matches part of the file name
search needs a name or some text

results.error: Give a file name or some text to look for.

cases.name: undo of a change that was never recorded is refused

results.error: There is no such change to undo.

cases.name: a data URL is written as the bytes it carries
locate gives the full path of a file inside and refuses one outside
a data URL without padding is written as the bytes it decodes to
a data URL skips spaces and stops at the first equals sign
a data URL skips a character outside the alphabet
a data URL with one leftover character writes the whole groups
a data URL in the URL-safe alphabet is written as its bytes
a data URL with a non-Latin character takes its low byte
a data URL with nothing after the comma is written as plain text
a data URL of only equals signs writes an empty file
an image over 20 MB is refused

results.error: That image is 20 MB, over the 20 MB limit.

cases.name: a listing of more than 500 entries shows 500 and says so
a search walks at most 4000 files and says so
a search skips text over 512 KB and reads text exactly at the limit
a search hit keeps its line to 300 characters
a search hit keeps 300 UTF-16 units of an emoji line
a text file over 2 MB is refused

results.error: That file is 2048 KB, over the 2048 KB a single read allows. Ask for part of it instead.

cases.name: a listing sorts accented names with their base letter
a write is logged with its relative path, bytes and a checkpoint
an edit is logged with its bytes and a checkpoint
a refused read is logged by its relative path, not its basename
a search is logged with its hit count and no path
an undo is logged as a restore with its file count
a folder listing is logged with the folder path
